leo1a3dk.name: Leopard 1A3 DK
leo1a3dk.authority: Main ruled the Denmark line on 2026-10-29 (about 12:50, DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day ("add a bunch more denmark tanks"): Leopard 1A3 DK at tier I, a photo-class first-party build with its Danish kit; no registered 3D comparison exists for this configuration. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
leo1a3dk.envelopeBasis: Width is the as-built X extent over the 1A5 hull's skirts (published 3.41 m, Pansermuseet). Length is the as-built Z extent with the gun forward: the published 9.54 m (Pansermuseet: 6.94 m hull, 9.54 m with the gun at 12 o'clock) plus the bow tow eyes and stern can carriers, within 1.4%. Tallest is the tip of the two rear roof whips as built; the published height is 2.8 m over the commander's MG, which the fixture holds against the cupola. The welded turret is measured from the Krigsmuseet side view (Wikimedia Commons) scaled by the 0.74 m road-wheel pitch; docs/history/research/denmark-line-265.md records the stations.
